description: Detail for a Ukraine ProZorro tender that prozorro_get_tender can't resolve from a human tenderID — its tenderID-to-internal-id lookup only scans the most-recently-modified few thousand records (fleet #2762/#2768), so a tenderID found via prozorro_search_tenders' date-range browsing (e.g. a 2015 tender) comes back `detail_available:false` there. An internal 32-hex id ALWAYS resolves immediately regardless of age (a direct lookup, no scan needed). For a human tenderID this tries TWO live strategies before giving up: the same recently-modified scan prozorro_get_tender uses, then a bounded forward scan seeded from the DATE THE TENDERID ITSELF ENCODES ("UA-2015-02-16-..." -> search from 2015-02-16) — this finds it when the tender's last modification happened reasonably soon after that date, and does not when a later amendment moved it far down the feed; both are live, keyless, no stored data (fleet #3244). `source` says which path answered; `detail_available:false` (never a crash, never an empty object) means neither reached it, and only the search-index summary is available.

id.description: Tender id — internal 32-hex (e.g. "09076ffc415e4d57ad7046aacc91b6e1") or human tenderID (e.g. "UA-2015-02-16-000001").
